# Downcity

> Open-source Agent Harness and Agent Productization Kits for running agents and shipping reliable agent products. Downcity provides the runtime to run agents (Agent Harness), then packages them into deliverable products with City, Federation, SDKs, and UI kits.

The website is available in English and Chinese. All product documentation is pre-rendered as static HTML at `/en/` (English) and `/zh/` (Chinese) paths.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://downcity.ai/product/): what Downcity is and how the kits compose into a product.
- [Features](https://downcity.ai/features/): capabilities across the agent runtime and productization kits.
- [Quick start](https://downcity.ai/start/): install Downcity and run your first agent.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home (English)](https://downcity.ai/en/docs/)
- [Documentation home (Chinese)](https://downcity.ai/zh/docs/)
- [Agent SDK docs](https://downcity.ai/en/agent-sdk-docs/): run agent sessions, tools, and harness configuration.
- [City SDK docs](https://downcity.ai/en/city-sdk-docs/): build agent products on the City runtime.
- [Payments docs](https://downcity.ai/en/payments/): monetize agent products.
- [Plugins docs](https://downcity.ai/en/plugins-docs/): extend agents with plugin capabilities.
- [UI SDK docs](https://downcity.ai/en/ui-sdk-docs/): build interfaces for agent products.

## Blog

- [All articles](https://downcity.ai/en/blog/): the full list of Downcity articles.
- [What is an agent harness?](https://downcity.ai/en/blog/what-is-an-agent-harness/): the runtime layer that turns a model into a working agent, and how it differs from a framework or MCP.
- [The anatomy of an agent harness](https://downcity.ai/en/blog/the-anatomy-of-an-agent-harness/): one request traced end to end, the ten subsystems and what each one owns, plus a diagnostic table mapping production symptoms to missing subsystems.
- [Agent harness vs MCP](https://downcity.ai/en/blog/agent-harness-vs-mcp/): why they are different layers rather than rivals, where each boundary sits, and how they compose for one tool call.
- [智能体框架怎么选](https://downcity.ai/zh/blog/how-to-choose-an-agent-framework/)：先分清编排库、低代码平台与 Agent 运行时三类东西，再按四个维度选型（中文）。
